import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C {

	static BufferedReader br;
	static PrintWriter out;
	static StringTokenizer st;
	static boolean eof;

	static final int L = 16;
	static long[] repUnits = new long[L + 1];

	static {
		repUnits[1] = 1;
		for (int i = 2; i <= L; i++) {
			repUnits[i] = 10 * repUnits[i - 1] + 1;
		}
	}

	static long recurse(long val, int digits) {
		val = Math.abs(val);
		if (val == 0 || digits <= 0) return 0;
		
		long rep = repUnits[digits];
		if (val % rep == 0) {
			return (val / rep) * digits;
		}
		
		long lowerFactor = val / rep;
		long upperFactor = lowerFactor + 1;
		
		long lowerRemainder = val - lowerFactor * rep;
		long upperRemainder = upperFactor * rep - val;
		
		long option1 = lowerFactor * digits + recurse(lowerRemainder, digits - 1);
		long option2 = upperFactor * digits + recurse(upperRemainder, digits - 1);
		
		return Math.min(option1, option2);
	}

	static long compute(long input) {
		return recurse(input, L);
	}

	C() throws IOException {
		br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		out.println(compute(readLong()));
		out.close();
	}

	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		new C();
	}

	static String nextToken() {
		while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
			try {
				st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
			} catch (Exception e) {
				eof = true;
				return null;
			}
		}
		return st.nextToken();
	}

	static String nextLine() {
		try {
			return br.readLine();
		} catch (IOException e) {
			eof = true;
			return null;
		}
	}

	static int readInt() throws IOException {
		return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
	}

	static long readLong() throws IOException {
		return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
	}

	static double readDouble() throws IOException {
		return Double.parseDouble(nextToken());
	}
}
